description: One row per LIVE acceptance criterion. `proof` is a shell command that exits non-zero when the criterion is not met; null means the phase that owns it has not landed yet. ac-suite.sh --release fails if any row still has a null proof, so 'not written yet' can never be mistaken for 'passing'.
